Initiative_Tracker.Notes: Announced C73 Baylight supplemental. Luis Navarro feature. 3 tracks, 8 trades, 400+ Baylight placements by Year 3. No coverage since C73 — 12-cycle gap. Multiple milestones (OUSD MOU C76, Peralta MOU C78, budget allocation C80, A's commitment C83) unverified.
Initiative_Tracker.MilestoneNotes: C107: Public town hall enrollment event convened; applicant intake operational with cohort placement targets established.
